## Page 9

Plastic Packaging
Plastic Packaging are produced and sold by RBF. The plastic packaging available encompasses various types, depending 
on the raw materials used in production and the different chemical reactions involved. Each type of plastic produced has 
distinct properties and is utilized for different purposes. Production is carried out based on customer orders and is done in  
an OEM format, catering to customers in the food and beverage industry, as well as electronic component manufacturers. 
Additionally, the products are sold to general retail stores, with packaging sizes tailored to customer requirements.
